official_reference: Fairfax County DPSC/RapidDeploy MapServer layer 12 — Planned Building
data_date_basis: Layer metadata does not expose a feature-level data date; not invented.
license: Not stated in layer metadata; public accessibility stated.
evidence_slice: Fairfax County GIS DPSC/RapidDeploy layer 12 is named Planned Building, is a polygon Feature Layer, and is described as planned commercial and multi-family residential buildings captured from approved site plans for planning purposes. The service marks data accessibility as publicly available and supports JSON, geoJSON and PBF. The current retrieval transport could read the service layer metadata but could not retrieve the layer-12 feature-query payload, so no feature row, geometry, or building identifier was invented or accepted.
rejection_reason: official layer semantics are sufficient to identify a planned-building feature family, but no feature row/geometry was retrieved in this transport window of the current transport window; no building record accepted.
